name: 67420 · Beloit, KS
findings: ZIP 67420 (Beloit) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (71% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67420 (Beloit) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 67420 (Beloit) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
